main.title: Project Hail Mary
main.synopsis: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.
main.short_summary: An amnesiac astronaut must solve a cosmic mystery to save Earth.

main.title: Raised by Wolves
main.synopsis: After Earth is ravaged by a great religious war, an atheistic android architect sends two of his creations, Mother and Father, to start a peaceful, godless colony on the planet Kepler-22b. Their treacherous task is jeopardized by the arrival of the Mithraic, a deeply devout religious order of surviving humans.
main.short_summary: Two androids attempt to raise human children on a distant planet after Earth's collapse.

main.title: Predestination
main.synopsis: Predestination chronicles the life of a Temporal Agent sent on an intricate series of time-travel journeys designed to prevent future killers from committing their crimes. Now, on his final assignment, the Agent must stop the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time and prevent a devastating attack in which thousands of lives will be lost.
main.short_summary: A time-traveling agent pursues an elusive criminal on a final assignment.

main.title: Annihilation
main.synopsis: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
main.short_summary: A biologist joins a dangerous expedition into a mysterious, reality-altering zone.

main.title: Sunshine
main.synopsis: Fifty years into the future, the sun is dying, and Earth is threatened by arctic temperatures. A team of astronauts is sent to revive the Sun — but the mission fails. Seven years later, a new team is sent to finish the mission as mankind’s last hope.
main.short_summary: Astronauts undertake a desperate mission to reignite the dying Sun.

main.title: The Thirteenth Floor
main.synopsis: In Los Angeles, a wealthy man, known as Mr. Fuller, discovers a shocking secret about the world he lives in. Fearing for his life, he leaves a desperate message for a friend of his in the most unexpected place.
main.short_summary: A man's investigation exposes disturbing secrets about the nature of his reality.

main.title: Equilibrium
main.synopsis: In a dystopian future, a totalitarian regime maintains peace by subduing the populace with a drug, and displays of emotion are punishable by death. A man in charge of enforcing the law rises to overthrow the system.
main.short_summary: In a society that outlaws emotion, an enforcer begins to question the regime.

main.title: Mickey 17
main.synopsis: Unlikely hero Mickey Barnes finds himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job… to die, for a living.
main.short_summary: A disposable worker repeatedly dies and is replaced on a distant-world mission.

main.title: Solaris
main.synopsis: A troubled psychologist is sent to investigate the crew of an isolated research station orbiting a bizarre planet.
main.short_summary: A psychologist confronts strange phenomena aboard a station orbiting a mysterious planet.

main.title: Source Code
main.synopsis: When decorated soldier Captain Colter Stevens wakes up in the body of an unknown man, he discovers he's part of a mission to find the bomber of a Chicago commuter train.
main.short_summary: A soldier relives the final minutes before a train bombing to identify the attacker.

main.title: Midnight Special
main.synopsis: A father and son go on the run after the dad learns his child possesses special powers.
main.short_summary: A father flees with his son, whose extraordinary abilities attract dangerous attention.

main.title: The Endless
main.synopsis: Two brothers return to the cult they fled from years ago to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.
main.short_summary: Two brothers revisit a former cult and encounter inexplicable events.

main.title: Prospect
main.synopsis: A teenage girl and her father travel to a remote alien moon, aiming to strike it rich. They've secured a contract to harvest a large deposit of the elusive gems hidden in the depths of the moon's toxic forest. But there are others roving the wilderness and the job quickly devolves into a fight to survive.
main.short_summary: A father and daughter prospecting on a toxic alien moon face a fight for survival.

main.title: The Vast of Night
main.synopsis: At the dawn of the space-race, two radio-obsessed teens discover a strange frequency over the airwaves in what becomes the most important night of their lives and in the history of their small town.
main.short_summary: Two young radio enthusiasts discover an eerie signal in a small town.

main.title: Bugonia
main.synopsis: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.
main.short_summary: Two conspiracy theorists abduct a CEO they believe is an extraterrestrial.

main.title: Pandorum
main.synopsis: Two crew members wake up on an abandoned spacecraft with no idea who they are, how long they've been asleep, or what their mission is. The two soon discover they're actually not alone – and the reality of their situation is more horrifying than they could have imagined.
main.short_summary: Two astronauts awaken aboard a seemingly abandoned ship with no memory of their mission.

main.title: The Artifice Girl
main.synopsis: A team of special agents discovers a revolutionary new computer program to bait and trap online predators. After teaming up with the program's troubled developer, they soon find that the AI is rapidly advancing beyond its original purpose.
main.short_summary: Investigators discover that a crime-fighting AI is evolving beyond its intended purpose.

main.title: Ad Astra
main.synopsis: The near future, a time when both hope and hardships drive humanity to look to the stars and beyond. While a mysterious phenomenon menaces to destroy life on planet Earth, astronaut Roy McBride undertakes a mission across the immensity of space and its many perils to uncover the truth about a lost expedition that decades before boldly faced emptiness and silence in search of the unknown.
main.short_summary: An astronaut journeys across the solar system to investigate a threat tied to his father.

main.title: Solaris
main.synopsis: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a planet called Solaris to investigate the death of a doctor and the mental problems of cosmonauts on the station. He soon discovers that the water on the planet is a type of brain which brings out repressed memories and obsessions.
main.short_summary: A psychologist investigates unsettling events aboard a station orbiting an enigmatic planet.

main.title: Timecrimes
main.synopsis: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.
main.short_summary: An accidental trip into the recent past sets off a dangerous chain of events.

main.title: Primer
main.synopsis: A group of fledgling inventors discover a complex method to manipulate reality. At first, they successfully game the stock market with it, but the consequences of the invention start to catch up with them.
main.short_summary: Two engineers stumble upon a time-altering invention with increasingly tangled consequences.

main.title: Aniara
main.synopsis: A ship carrying settlers to a new home on Mars after Earth is rendered uninhabitable is knocked off-course, causing the passengers to consider their place in the universe.
main.short_summary: A spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars drifts off course, leaving its passengers adrift.

main.title: Under the Skin
main.short_summary: A mysterious woman travels through Scotland, luring unsuspecting men into danger.
main.synopsis: A seductive stranger prowls the streets of Glasgow in search of prey: unsuspecting men who fall under her spell.

main.title: High Life
main.synopsis: Monte and his daughter are the last survivors of a damned and dangerous mission to deep space. The crew—death-row inmates led by a doctor with sinister motives—has vanished. As the mystery of what happened onboard the ship is unraveled, father and daughter must rely on each other to survive as they hurtle toward the oblivion of a black hole.
main.short_summary: A father and daughter struggle to survive aboard a doomed deep-space vessel.

main.title: Upstream Color
main.synopsis: A man and woman are drawn together, entangled in the lifecycle of an ageless organism. Identity becomes an illusion as they struggle to assemble the loose fragments of wrecked lives.
main.short_summary: Two strangers struggle to rebuild their identities after a bizarre biological encounter.

main.title: Fast Color
main.synopsis: A woman is forced to go on the run when her superhuman abilities are discovered. Years after having abandoned her family, the only place she has left to hide is home.
main.short_summary: A woman with unusual powers returns home while evading those pursuing her.

main.title: Sputnik
main.synopsis: At the height of the Cold War, a Soviet spacecraft crash lands after a mission gone awry, leaving the commander as its only survivor. After a renowned Russian psychologist is brought in to evaluate the commander’s mental state, it becomes clear that something dangerous may have come back to Earth with him…
main.short_summary: A Soviet cosmonaut returns from space carrying something terrifying.

main.title: Splice
main.synopsis: Elsa and Clive, two rebellious young scientists, defy legal and ethical boundaries and forge ahead with a dangerous experiment: splicing together human and animal DNA to create a new organism. Named "Dren", the creature rapidly develops from a deformed female infant into a beautiful but dangerous winged human-chimera, who forges a bond with both of her creators — only to have that bond turn deadly.
main.short_summary: Two scientists create a human-animal hybrid whose rapid development defies their control.

main.title: Tau
main.synopsis: Held captive in a futuristic smart house, a woman hopes to escape by befriending the A.I. program that controls the house.
main.short_summary: A captive woman attempts to outwit the AI controlling her high-tech prison.

main.title: Lockout
main.synopsis: Set in the near future, Lockout follows a falsely convicted ex-government agent , whose one chance at obtaining freedom lies in the dangerous mission of rescuing the President's daughter from rioting convicts at an outer space maximum security prison.
main.short_summary: A disgraced agent is sent to rescue the president's daughter from a space prison.

candidates.title: What Happened to Monday
candidates.synopsis: In a world where families are limited to one child due to overpopulation, a set of identical septuplets must avoid being put to a long sleep by the government and dangerous infighting while investigating the disappearance of one of their own.
candidates.short_summary: Seven identical sisters hide their existence in a one-child society until one disappears.

candidates.title: Captive State
candidates.synopsis: Nearly a decade after occupation by an extraterrestrial force, the lives of a Chicago neighborhood on both sides of the conflict are explored. In a working-class Chicago neighborhood occupied by an alien force for nine years, increased surveillance and the restriction of civil rights have given rise to an authoritarian system -- and dissent among the populace.
candidates.short_summary: In occupied Chicago, resistance and collaboration collide under alien rule.

candidates.title: Mars Express
candidates.synopsis: In 2200, private detective Aline Ruby and her android partner Carlos Rivera are hired by a wealthy businessman to track down a notorious hacker. On Mars, they descend deep into the underbelly of the planet's capital city where they uncover a darker story of brain farms, political corruption, and a missing girl who holds a secret about the robots that threatens to change the face of the universe.
candidates.short_summary: A detective and her android partner uncover a conspiracy on a futuristic Mars.

candidates.title: The Girl with All the Gifts
candidates.synopsis: In the future, a strange fungus has changed nearly everyone into thoughtless, flesh-eating monsters. When a scientist and a teacher find a girl who seems to be immune to the fungus, they all begin a journey to save humanity.
candidates.short_summary: A gifted young girl may hold the key to survival in a world overrun by infection.

candidates.title: Automata
candidates.synopsis: Jacq Vaucan, an insurance agent of ROC robotics corporation, routinely investigates the case of manipulating a robot. What he discovers will have profound consequences for the future of humanity.
candidates.short_summary: An insurance investigator discovers that robots may be evolving beyond their programming.

candidates.title: The Machine
candidates.synopsis: Already deep into a second Cold War, Britain’s Ministry of Defense seeks a game-changing weapon. Programmer Vincent McCarthy unwittingly provides an answer in The Machine, a super-strong human cyborg. When a programming bug causes the prototype to decimate his lab, McCarthy takes his obsessive efforts underground, far away from inquisitive eyes.
candidates.short_summary: A defense scientist's experimental AI weapon develops an unexpected identity.

candidates.title: Freaks
candidates.synopsis: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat—or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what's really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn't so simple, the danger is very real.
candidates.short_summary: A sheltered girl begins questioning her father's warnings about the world outside.

candidates.title: The Wandering Earth
candidates.synopsis: When the Sun begins to expand in such a way that it will inevitably engulf and destroy the Earth in a hundred years, united mankind finds a way to avoid extinction by propelling the planet out of the Solar System using gigantic engines, moving it to a new home located four light years away, an epic journey that will last thousands of years.
candidates.short_summary: Humanity attempts to move Earth itself to escape the expanding Sun.

candidates.title: The Congress
candidates.synopsis: An aging, out-of-work actress accepts one last job, though the consequences of her decision affect her in ways she didn't consider.
candidates.short_summary: An actress sells her digital likeness and enters a strange new entertainment industry.

candidates.title: The Town
candidates.synopsis: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.
candidates.short_summary: A bank robber's relationship with a hostage complicates his criminal life.

candidates.title: End of Watch
candidates.synopsis: Two young officers are marked for death after confiscating a small cache of money and firearms from the members of a notorious cartel during a routine traffic stop.
candidates.short_summary: Two Los Angeles police officers become targets after a dangerous encounter.

candidates.title: Thief
candidates.synopsis: Frank is an expert professional safecracker, specialized in high-profile diamond heists. He plans to use his ill-gotten income to retire from crime and build a nice life for himself complete with a home, wife and kids. To accelerate the process, he signs on with a top gangster for a big score.
candidates.short_summary: A skilled safecracker risks his independence for one last lucrative job.

candidates.title: 12 Monkeys
candidates.short_summary: A prisoner travels into the past to investigate the origins of a devastating plague.

candidates.title: Strange Days
candidates.synopsis: In the last days of 1999, ex-cop turned street hustler Lenny Nero receives a disc which contains the memories of the murder of a prostitute. With the help of bodyguard Mace, he starts to investigate and is pulled deeper and deeper in a whirl of murder, blackmail and intrigue.
candidates.short_summary: A former cop uncovers a deadly conspiracy involving recorded human memories.

candidates.title: The Lives of Others
candidates.synopsis: In 1984 East Berlin, dedicated Stasi officer Gerd Wiesler begins spying on a famous playwright and his actress-lover Christa-Maria. Wiesler becomes unexpectedly sympathetic to the couple, and faces conflicting loyalties when his superior takes a liking to Christa-Maria.
candidates.short_summary: An East German surveillance officer becomes entangled in the lives of the artists he monitors.

candidates.title: Counterpart
candidates.synopsis: Howard Silk is a lowly cog in a bureaucratic UN agency who is turning the last corner of a life filled with regret when he discovers the agency he works for is guarding a secret: a crossing to a parallel dimension.
candidates.short_summary: A bureaucrat discovers that his agency conceals a passage to a parallel world.

candidates.title: Pantheon
candidates.synopsis: A bullied teen receives mysterious help from someone online: a stranger soon revealed to be her recently deceased father, David, whose consciousness has been uploaded to the Cloud following an experimental destructive brain scan. David is the first of a new kind of being – an “Uploaded Intelligence” or “UI” – but he will not be the last, as a global conspiracy unfolds that threatens to trigger a new kind of world war.
candidates.short_summary: A teenager learns that her dead father's consciousness may have survived online.

candidates.title: Severance
candidates.synopsis: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.
candidates.short_summary: Employees whose work and personal memories are separated begin questioning their employer.

candidates.title: Years and Years
candidates.synopsis: As Britain is rocked by unstable political, economic and technological advances, members of the Lyons family converge on one crucial night in 2019. Over the next 15 years, the twists and turns of their everyday lives are explored as we find out if this ordinary family could change the world.
candidates.short_summary: One British family's lives unfold amid years of political and technological upheaval.

candidates.title: Devs
candidates.synopsis: Young computer engineer Lily Chan investigates the secretive development division of her employer, a cutting-edge tech company based in San Francisco, which she believes is behind the murder of her boyfriend.
candidates.short_summary: A software engineer investigates a secretive tech division after her boyfriend disappears.

candidates.title: Dark
candidates.synopsis: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.
candidates.short_summary: A missing child draws four families into a mystery spanning generations.

candidates.title: Humans
candidates.synopsis: In a parallel present where the latest must-have gadget for any busy family is a 'Synth' - a highly-developed robotic servant that's so similar to a real human it's transforming the way we live.
candidates.short_summary: Humanlike robotic servants transform everyday life in a near-future society.
